action.command:
echo "=== MinIO buckets via server-internal mc? try s3api list via curl (needs sig). Use mc in createbuckets container image instead ==="
docker run --rm --network host minio/mc:RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z sh -c '
MC_HOST="http://$(cat /workspace/.secrets/minio_root_user 2>/dev/null):$(cat /workspace/.secrets/minio_root_password 2>/dev/null)@127.0.0.1:9000" mc alias set local >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
' 2>&1 | head -5
echo "--- secrets dir ---"
ls -la /workspace/.secrets/ 2>/dev/null
cat /workspace/.secrets/* 2>/dev/null | head -20
